sentiment.rationale: Forward guidance was reduced: fiscal 2027 adjusted operating profit is expected to decline 13% to 8% in constant currency, and adjusted diluted EPS is guided to $3.00-$3.20, down from $3.55 in fiscal 2026. Management's language is hedged, citing a 'challenging consumer backdrop' and 'elevated inflation,' and the company's own fiscal 2027 organic net sales guidance ranges from down 1.5% to up 0.5%, indicating no clear improvement. While the fourth quarter beat backward-looking comparisons, the forward outlook is explicitly weaker, warranting a negative score.

summary.revenue: Fiscal 2026 net sales were $18.4 billion, down 5 percent; fourth-quarter net sales were $4.6 billion, up 1 percent. Organic net sales were down 2 percent for the full year and flat in the fourth quarter.
summary.eps: Fiscal 2026 diluted loss per share was $0.16 compared to EPS of $4.10 last year; adjusted diluted EPS was $3.55, down 16 percent in constant currency. Fourth-quarter diluted loss per share was $3.74; adjusted diluted EPS was $0.95, up 27 percent in constant currency.
summary.guidance: Fiscal 2027 outlook: organic net sales expected to range between down 1.5 percent and up 0.5 percent; adjusted operating profit expected to be down 13 percent to down 8 percent in constant currency; adjusted diluted EPS expected between $3.00 and $3.20; free cash flow conversion approximately 95 percent of adjusted after-tax earnings. The company targets $3 billion in cumulative cost savings by fiscal 2030, with $750 million expected in fiscal 2027.
summary.margin: Fiscal 2026 adjusted gross margin was 33.5 percent, down 100 basis points; adjusted operating profit margin was 15.3 percent, down 190 basis points. Fourth-quarter adjusted gross margin was 34.2 percent, up 150 basis points; adjusted operating profit margin was 15.3 percent, up 160 basis points.
key_risks: Elevated input cost inflation (4% to 5% of COGS expected in fiscal 2027)
Challenging consumer backdrop and weaker consumer sentiment

Approximately 9 points of headwinds on adjusted operating profit and 11 points on EPS in fiscal 2027 from lapping the 53rd week, normalizing corporate incentive expense, and the impact of fiscal 2026 divestitures
Non-cash goodwill and brand intangible asset charges driven by an increase in discount rates
Non-cash valuation loss related to the planned divestiture of the Brazil business
Potential impact of tariffs and supply chain disruptions
key_opportunities: $750 million in cost savings expected in fiscal 2027 from HMM, global transformation initiative, and other efficiency efforts
Targeting $3 billion in cumulative cost savings by fiscal 2030
Increased innovation and renovation centered on consumer benefits (better-for-you, bold flavors, fun and indulgence, pet humanization)
Favorable net price realization and mix
Growth in International segment (Brazil, Europe, India, China)
